item.title: AI doubts resurface as AMD slides 7% premarket on soft sales outlook
item.description: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) shares fell nearly 7% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the chipmaker's lacklustre quarterly sales forecast rekindled investor doubts over its ability to take on AI chip bellwether Nvidia, Azernews reports, citing Tribune.

item.title: US bound EV exports fall 90% in 2025
item.description: Korea’s electric vehicle (EV) exports to the United States plunged by nearly 90 percent last year, weighed down by Washington’s auto tariffs and the rollback of EV subsidies under the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump, industry data showed on Wednesday, Azernews reports, citing Korean media.

item.title: Fuel leaks persist on NASA’s Artemis rocket
item.description: NASA was forced to end a critical fueling test of its giant Artemis 2 rocket early Tuesday morning, delaying the mission to send astronauts around the Moon by at least a month. Now, as the sun rises on the big orange launch vehicle, the space agency is trying to clarify what went wrong — and much of what it’s saying sounds all too familiar, Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Azerbaijan’s AI push gains momentum with new Israel partnership
item.description: For Azerbaijan, the cooperation with Israel offers a unique opportunity to leapfrog over common AI integration challenges. By taking lessons from Israel’s advanced AI landscape, Azerbaijan can accelerate its own digital transformation, laying the groundwork for a future where AI not only powers economic growth but also enhances the quality of life for its citizens. item.title: Tajikistan begins transition to 12-year education
item.description: The Ministry of Education and Science of Tajikistan, acting on behalf of the country’s leadership, has begun preparations for a phased transition to a 12-year general education system, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan, UAE foreign ministers meet in Abu Dhabi to discuss strategic partnership
item.description: On February 4, 2026, Azerbaijan’s Minister of Foreign Affairs Jeyhun Bayramov held talks in Abu Dhabi with the United Arab Emirates’ Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

item.title: ADB approves $2 mln for private capital mobilization projec in Azerbaijan and Asia
item.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has approved technical assistance worth 2 million USD to support the implementation of the “Private Capital Mobilization Indicator Preparation and Implementation” project. Azerbaijan, as one of the developing countries, is participating in this project.

item.title: Footage of Zayed Award for Human Fraternity ceremony posted on President Ilham Aliyev's social media accounts
item.description: Footage from the Zayed Award for Human Fraternity ceremony in Abu Dhabi was posted on President Ilham Aliyev's social media accounts, Azernews reports.

item.title: Heydar Aliyev Center hosts exhibition 'Superheroes of Wildlife'
item.description: On February 4, the grand opening of the exhibition "The Superheroes of Wildlife" by renowned British and Australian sculptors Gillie and Marc Schattner took place at the Heydar Aliyev Center in Baku, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan, Sri Lanka discuss expanding ties in energy, tourism and education
item.description: At the invitation of the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, Azerbaijan’s non-resident ambassador to the country, Elchin Huseynli, paid a visit to the capital Colombo on February 4 to attend events marking Sri Lanka’s national holiday—Independence Day, Azernews reports, citing the Embassy of the Republic of Azerbaijan in India.
